name: Jordan Example
paragraphs: Your Senior Data Engineer role asks for someone who can move a legacy warehouse to Snowflake without breaking the morning reports. That is the last project I finished.

At Example Analytics I moved 140 SQL Server jobs to Snowflake and dbt and cut nightly load time from 6 hours to 40 minutes. I also added freshness and row-count checks that caught more than 30 upstream failures before anyone saw a bad number.
I work remotely, and I'm available for a W2 contract or full-time role starting in two weeks.
I'd welcome a short call to talk through your migration plans.
